rationale: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with ~condition, control releveled, a minimal rowSums<10 filter, apeglm shrinkage, alpha=0.05 and an explicit low-power caveat fit the 3v3 unpaired single-batch design well. QC has PCA and a distance heatmap but no library-size check or outlier/shallow-sample policy, and normalization via size factors is implied by DESeq() but never stated. Enrichment stays organism-native (GO via org.Dr.eg.db, Reactome filtered to Danio rerio) and the ortholog path via babelgene reports mapping rate and prefers one-to-one orthologs, but no collection or ortholog-table versions, no Ensembl release, no GO-coverage caveat, and no set-size window are given. The report names counts at both tiers and the design caveat but omits package and annotation versions.
